description: One listing by VIN: every field of the search record plus its asking-price history on this seller, and battery_warranty, this car's high-voltage battery warranty as its Census EV page gives it: status (for example "Expired" or "In force · 38,200 mi or 3+ yr left"), in_force, and estimated when the term is not the manufacturer's own figure. battery_warranty is absent where the page gives no verdict for the car. asking_vs_similar ("below", "typical" or "above") compares the asking price with similar cars on Census EV: the same version and model year within 40,000 miles, adjusted for mileage, counting cars listed now and cars no longer listed in the last 30 days at their last asking price. It compares asking prices and is not an appraisal. "below" and "above" need a gap of at least $1,000 that is also wider than the usual spread of asking prices for that version: for most cars about 3 to 7% over for "above" and about 5 to 9% under for "below", more where few similar cars are known, and "below" must still hold with any one similar car left out. Otherwise it is "typical". Absent when the car could not be compared: new or under 2,000 miles, no asking price or mileage, a disclosed buyback or branded title, fewer than 3 similar cars, similar cars that are not all one version, or an asking price so far under them that the gap is more than 30% of it. The seller link forwards through censusev.com to the dealer's own page for the car.
name: get_listing
title: Get one listing by VIN
